meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 只写 Conventional Commits 格式的提交信息,压缩到只讲意图,并输出成可直接粘贴的代码块。它不运行 git commit、不暂存文件、不做 amend。
howto.when: 当你说「write a commit」「commit message」,或用 /commit、/caveman-commit 时接管。说「stop caveman-commit」或「normal mode」则回到啰嗦的提交风格。

say.text: 帮我给这次改动写条提交信息
say.note: 输出可直接粘贴的代码块

say.text: 这是破坏性改动,写提交信息并注明迁移
say.note: 会附带 BREAKING CHANGE 段落

say.text: 用 caveman-commit 压缩这条 commit message

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude writes commit messages in Conventional Commits format compressed to intent only, returned as a paste-ready code block. It does not run git commit, stage files, or amend.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "write a commit" or "commit message", or use /commit or /caveman-commit. Say "stop caveman-commit" or "normal mode" to return to verbose style.

say_en.text: write a commit message for these changes
this is a breaking change, write the commit message with migration notes
compress this commit message with caveman-commit
